[Delphine PA Dang]{.hero-name}

[Hi, I'm Delphine, a Vietnamese artist and researcher-in-training based in Sydney. My research brings together political theory, data science and statistical methods; my art moves between film, music and performance. Both are ways of asking questions about politics, identity and power.]{.hero-lede}

### An Eye for an I

An audiovisual piece that translates my research on large language models into sound and image. Presented at the Charles Perkins Centre EMCR Symposium and the Parramatta Lanes pop-up gallery.

[Watch the film →](art-music.qmd#an-eye-for-an-i)
